## About
Mid-County Collision Center is an auto body and paint shop on Ulmerton Rd in Largo. From minor dents to major collisions, whether you have one car, RV or a large truck, we fix vehicles for people across Pinellas County and the Bay area.
We work with individual vehicle owners, businesses and municipalities, and we try to make the whole thing easy on you and on your insurance company. One customer called us a "great family business," and one reviewer said Rick "was awesome and very personal and you can tell he cares."
Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 248 Google reviews. We want you to be completely satisfied with our repairs, and if you're not, we'll do everything we can to make it right.

## Services
- Insurance Collision Repair & Paint: Collision repair and painting, with friendly, personal service for both you and your insurance company.
- Frame Straightening: Getting your frame back where it belongs after a collision.
- RV & Large Truck Body Repairs: Whether you have one car, RV or a large truck, we can repair the body.
- Auto Body Repairs: From minor dents to major collisions, we'll take care of it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call to request a free estimate.

Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We welcome all major insurance companies and work with both you and your insurer through the repair.

Q: Can I get a rental car while my car is in the shop?
A: One reviewer said it was easy to coordinate a rental car with the Enterprise down the street.

Q: Do you work on vehicles for businesses?
A: Yes. We serve individual vehicle owners, businesses and municipalities throughout Pinellas County.
